extra.summary: DBS Vantage Card is one of the credit cards in Singapore with a high earn rate for both local and overseas spend, with the flexibility to switch between miles and cashback, along with benefits such as dining and travel privileges catered for both locally and abroad.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: While the Annual Fee is strictly non-waivable for the first year, you will enjoy a waiver in the subsequent years if a minimum of S$60,000 worth of retail spend is made in the preceding Card Year

our_takes.our-take: The DBS Vantage card suits those who value flexible rewards, offering both miles (up to 2.2 per S$1) and cashback (up to 2.2%) options. The Accor Plus membership with a free night stay adds value for frequent travellers. However, the relatively high S$599.50 annual fee (waived only with S$60,000 annual spend) and S$27 miles conversion fee mean you should spend strategically to maximize benefits and offset costs. The 3-year expiry on points is a drawback compared to cards with unlimited expiry.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent individuals who want to earn accelerated rewards on both local and overseas spending.
Travel enthusiasts seeking complimentary airport lounge access and a free hotel night annually.
High-income earners who can meet the annual fee or spending requirements for ongoing benefits.
our_takes.things-to-note:
The S$599.50 annual fee can outweigh the benefits, so ensure rewards earned justify the cost.
Points/cashback expire after 3 years, so redeem them promptly to avoid losing your benefits.
A S$27 fee applies per DBS Points to miles conversion, impacting the value of your rewards.
